subject: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Collins <emma.collins@outreach.io>, Outreach Procurement <procurement@outreach.io>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

Team —

Thank you for getting the shortlists over the last two weeks. We need to lock a recommendation by end of day Friday so Legal/Finance can finalize the PO and we can start the cutover planning for Q3. High-level asks for this thread:

- Confirm final commercial (T&Cs + price) and provide any non-standard redlines Outreach expects.
- Attach security/compliance evidence (SOC2, pen test summary, data retention options).
- Call out any mandatory migration windows or training lead-times that would push us past the July 1st target.

Emma — can you confirm Outreach's final quote and share the security bundle? I attached the comparator we built vs Salesloft (internal) — please use that as the canonical price baseline.

I'll coordinate a short internal decision call tomorrow morning (09:30 PT) if anyone thinks we need one.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Outreach_Final_Quote_20280509.pdf, Outreach_Security_Evidence_20280509.zip

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@outreach.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Outreach Procurement <procurement@outreach.io>
Date: 2028-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear asks. Attaching the final quote and the security evidence bundle. Key points on our side:

- Standard enterprise SOW + 12 month commitment. Price in attached PDF is net of a partner discount we can extend if you sign by 2028-05-20.
- We can support July 1st cutover but need a 3-week overlap for mailbox and sequence handoffs (training + QA).
- No mandatory API or IP redlines in the quote; standard DPA + SOC2 controls included.

Quoted attachments: Outreach_Final_Quote_20280509.pdf, Outreach_Security_Evidence_20280509.zip

If it helps, I can join tomorrow's decision call to walk the team through the quote and the training runbook.

Best,
Emma Collins
Strategic Accounts — Outreach
emma.collins@outreach.io

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

Thanks Emma — quick read looks reasonable. Two internal flags:

1) The Outreach quote includes a per-seat training retainer (line 4) that pushes TCV up ~14% in year one. Can we trade that for a 6-week onboarding schedule from their professional services team instead?

2) Soojin — the security bundle includes pen test summary but no explicit mention of our retention encryption key options. Can you confirm if that is a blocker for SOC/restricted customers?

If neither item is a hard stop, I lean to accept the partner discount window and move to Legal for redline. Deadline: sign by 05/20 to keep the pricing.

-Ben

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

On Fri, May 10, 2028 at 11:45 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Emma — quick read looks reasonable. Two internal flags:
>
> 1) The Outreach quote includes a per-seat training retainer (line 4) that pushes TCV up ~14% in year one. Can we trade that for a 6-week onboarding schedule from their professional services team instead?
>
> 2) Soojin — the security bundle includes pen test summary but no explicit mention of our retention encryption key options. Can you confirm if that is a blocker for SOC/restricted customers?

Ben — I reviewed the zip. Outreach supports BYOK for data-at-rest in the Dedicated offering but only for private deployments; hosted SaaS has envelope encryption managed by Outreach. That means for a small subset of restricted customers we will need a Dedicated or a contractual carve-out (narrow scoping) — both are feasible but add ~6-10 weeks to delivery and require Legal signoff.

Action: if we accept hosted SaaS we need to: 1) document the customer segmentation for which Outreach is acceptable, and 2) add playbooks for customers requiring Dedicated.

Not a blocker for the initial decision if we are comfortable with that delivery tradeoff.

-Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

Internal decision notes after huddle: 

- Consensus: proceed with Outreach conditional on two negotiated items: remove the per-seat training retainer OR convert it to a credits-based training pool; and add contractual language for data-retention segmentation + escalation path for customers needing Dedicated.
- Owner for negotiation: Ben to lead commercial push, Soojin to lead security carve-outs, Irene to coordinate Legal/Finance hand-off.
- Risk: if Outreach won't modify the training retainer, Salesloft total cost (baseline attached) becomes competitive — see Salesloft_Comparator_Pricing_Notes.xlsx. We should request a small counter from Salesloft for leverage if Outreach is firm.

Next step: Ben and Soojin draft a concise ask email to Outreach by EOD so Emma has time to respond before the pricing window closes.

-Marissa

From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@outreach.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement tooling decision runway and vendor gap notes

Thanks all — appreciate the clear asks. Quick update: 

- We can convert the per-seat training retainer into a 2000-credit training pool (covers onboarding waves) with no change to annual TCV.
- For retention and BYOK: hosted SaaS remains Outreach-managed for redwood's hosted instances, but we are happy to add contract language committing to a documented segmentation playbook and an expedited path to Dedicated for named accounts; will add that as a contract appendix.
- I've uploaded an updated quote and a DocuSign link for a preliminary statement of work. If you like the change, I'll mark the offer as valid through 2028-05-20.

Links/attachments: Outreach_Final_Quote_20280509.pdf (updated), Outreach_Security_Evidence_20280509.zip, https://www.docusign.com/p/Outreach-Redwood-SOW-20280512

If you want, I can set up a 20-minute call with our PS lead to go over onboarding credit usage.

Best,
Emma

Note: attachments referenced in messages above are stubs only (filenames). The thread is stored in Irene's Gmail mailbox and covers internal decision coordination and vendor negotiation for sales engagement tooling procurement.
